items.heading: Barbagiuan
details: Key ingredients: pastry dough, pumpkin, ricotta, rice
Mix mashed pumpkin, ricotta cheese and cooked rice for the filling.
Roll pastry dough thin and cut into small squares.
Fill and fold each square into a small parcel.
Deep-fry until golden and crisp.

items.heading: Socca
details: Key ingredients: chickpea flour, olive oil, water
Whisk chickpea flour with water, olive oil and salt into a thin batter.
Let the batter rest so the flour hydrates fully.
Pour onto a very hot oiled pan or griddle.
Cook until the edges crisp and the center sets, then serve warm.

items.heading: Stocafi
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
